summary: A Yes vote adopts a limited city charter for Benicia that continues its council-manager form of government and allows the Measure Z real property transfer tax to take effect if voters approve both Measures Y and Z.

tax.text: A Yes vote would allow Benicia to become a limited charter city and make it possible to levy a real property transfer tax.
tax.quote: Measure Y, if passed, would make Benicia a limited charter city and make it possible to implement the second measure to levy a real property transfer tax, as Benicia currently cannot levy real property transfer taxes above the transfer tax cap of $0.55 per $1,000.

tax.text: A No vote would leave Benicia unable to levy real property transfer taxes above the existing cap.
